title: Ruffle Jacquard Cap Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this elegant evening dress! Featuring a luxurious jacquard fabric, delicate ruffle details, and charming cap sleeves, this gown exudes timeless sophistication. Perfect for formal events, it hugs your curves beautifully while offering a graceful, floor-sweeping silhouette.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises jacquard.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
